# Anne Shirley & Harrison

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) — good friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P45](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0045)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is daydreaming on her porch when Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) furiously confronts her about her cow breaking into his oats. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) retorts about his baldness before agreeing to keep the cow secured. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss the encounter over tea alongside news of new residents moving into [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss their plans for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) while driving home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). Spotting a cow in Mr. Harrison's grain field, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells it to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) thinking it is her own cow, Dolly. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers Dolly is still in the pen and realizes she sold Mr. Harrison's cow by mistake, leading her to set off to apologize with a peace-offering cake.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow instead of her own, and offers her own cow in exchange. To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the mistake good-naturedly, accepts her cake, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a friendly meal and clearing up the misunderstanding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to recount her successful evening.
>
> — v2 · III Mr. Harrison at Home

> On the eve of the school year, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate teaching methods, particularly whether corporal punishment is ever justified. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home, stops to visit Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)—who also doubts her gentle discipline approach—and goes to bed feeling anxious about her first day as a teacher. The next morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and gives her advice before she sets off.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) neighbors for subscriptions to the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), facing various eccentric and difficult residents. They seize an opportunity at Lorenzo White's house following the birth of his new son and secure a generous five-dollar donation. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) makes one final attempt by visiting Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), though he flatly refuses to contribute.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), truthfulness, and the Village Improvement Society's hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it was accidentally painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the society members are devastated, the incident earns them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a peaceful walk home along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and chats with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted for his trickery and lying, eventually breaking down in remorse and promising to reform before being sent to bed.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> In an irritable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing fireworks to explode in the classroom and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Returning home in despair, she confesses to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who comforts her and reassures her that everyone makes mistakes. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is amazed to find that whipping Anthony actually won his respect, a fact later confirmed by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) on a spring walk across the woods and fields to celebrate her adopted birthday. During their excursion, the girls explore unfamiliar paths, name a woodland pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and discover Hester Gray's hidden old garden. Sitting among the narcissi, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the poignant love story of Hester and [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and a grand dinner for the guest of honor, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and the dinner suffers from cooking mishaps and damaged property. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter explaining Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, making sense of the day's disappointment.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> After a newspaper item pokes fun at Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a sudden and devastating severe hail storm hits [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, only to find extensive damage to crops, trees, and windows across the village. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) grieves the loss of his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as the community takes stock of the destruction.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> A surprising visitor arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and announces that she is his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The news quickly spreads through [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), leading to rumors and curiosity. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who sheepishly admits he is glad his wife has returned before preparing to explain the full story of their past separation.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated after arguments over housecleaning, grammar, and his swearing parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), though they have now reconciled. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) returns with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, and expresses her joy at being back with her husband. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hears the latest gossip from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before putting a sleepy [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her two-year term as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher, prompting the local village women to gossip about the town's future, her pupils' love for her, and Stephen Irving's sudden arrival in town. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to relay a message to Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the message to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help a nervous Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before heading to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to help Miss Lavendar and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for the wedding. The wedding ceremony takes place in the garden, attended by guests including Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) return to lock up the house and share a quiet, romantic moment together.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
